headline: Review of bills, invoices, contract change orders, policies, charitable requests, capital project payments, and approved training offerings.
summary: The board will review and approve payment of bills, invoices, dues, and contract change orders. It will also discuss policies and contracts, charitable requests, correspondence, capital project documentation, and approved training and conference offerings.
items: Approval of Bills and Signing of Checks
Approval of Payment of Invoices, Dues, Requests for Payments and Contract Change Orders
Review of Approved for Payment Capital Project Invoices, Requisitions for Payment, and all other applicable Project Documentation
Review of Approved Training and Conference Offerings
location: Library, 630 Salem Street, Malden, MA 02148 (also available via Zoom)
